Armored Treasure.Description: Prove that three Europan Exos have been destroyed and I will pay you handsomely. These mechanised infantry have slaughtered many of our comrades, and I want revenge.
Armored Treasure.Author: Kane
Armored Treasure.StartDialogue:
Our young soldiers witness Europan Exo troops butchering their kin, and see them as gods of the battlefield...untouchable.
This is unacceptable to us.
We need to inspire our young forces by setting an example.
Destroy three of these Europan Exos – and bring us pieces of their mechanical corpses as proof...
...proof that only false gods, bleed.
Armored Treasure.EndDialogue:
Our young soldiers witness Europan Exo troops butchering their kin, and see them as gods of the battlefield...untouchable.
This is unacceptable to us.
We need to inspire our young forces by setting an example.
Destroy three of these Europan Exos – and bring us pieces of their mechanical corpses as proof...
...proof that only false gods, bleed.

Kursk's Children.Description: Those damned Eurasian relic T90s are suddenly tearing our forces apart. Stratcom suspects they've had a hardware update. Bring us components from destroyed T90s and we can see how they have been modified.
Kursk's Children.Author: Luca
Kursk's Children.StartDialogue:
You know those old Soviet-era tanks the Eurasians like to use?
The T-90s, specifically? They're suddenly becoming a problem for our forces.
We've had reports that their performance has increased significantly – Stratcom suspects they've received some kind of upgrade.
I need you to scrounge up components from destroyed T-90s.
We'll study them and see what's behind this new lethality.
Kursk's Children.EndDialogue:
You know those old Soviet-era tanks the Eurasians like to use?
The T-90s, specifically? They're suddenly becoming a problem for our forces.
We've had reports that their performance has increased significantly – Stratcom suspects they've received some kind of upgrade.
I need you to scrounge up components from destroyed T-90s.
We'll study them and see what's behind this new lethality.

Harvest Upgraded Mechanicals.Description: Europan Merkava tanks may be legends of the old times, but countless upgrades have kept them lethal even in this age. Our forces rarely have the opportunity to salvage these wonderful 'chariots'. If you can acquire 3 pieces of Merkava tech, we will reward you.
Harvest Upgraded Mechanicals.Author: Kane
Harvest Upgraded Mechanicals.StartDialogue:
Those Europan Merkavas may be ancient relics from a bygone era...
But with modern upgrades and tinkering, they're still some of the most feared machines on the battlefield.
We seek to understand these new-generation updates – with three specific tech components.
Will you help us?
Harvest Upgraded Mechanicals.EndDialogue:
Those Europan Merkavas may be ancient relics from a bygone era...
But with modern upgrades and tinkering, they're still some of the most feared machines on the battlefield.
We seek to understand these new-generation updates – with three specific tech components.
Will you help us?

Hunt the Hunters.Description: Europan Hunter Killer teams are often deployed after significant Europan casualties or theft of Europan Property. If you can manage to retrieve components from their armor, we will make it worth the time and risk to your status. We suggest you let the battlefield do the dirty work for you, if you know what we mean.
Hunt the Hunters.Author: Kane
Hunt the Hunters.StartDialogue:
You are aware that those Europan Hunter Killer teams are like ghosts – always lurking...
... and they seem to appear out of thin air when they think someone's gotten too close to their precious assets or personnel.
We need to know how they perform these strange feats.
Recover some gear from one of these hunters. We'll make it worth your while.
Hunt the Hunters.EndDialogue:
You are aware that those Europan Hunter Killer teams are like ghosts – always lurking...
... and they seem to appear out of thin air when they think someone's gotten too close to their precious assets or personnel.
We need to know how they perform these strange feats.
Recover some gear from one of these hunters. We'll make it worth your while.

Cybernetic Heist.Description: Eurasian brawlers are deadly if you let them get too close. But they also have incredibly valuable components in their cyberbnetics. I don't care how you get them, but bring me three components.
Cybernetic Heist.Author: Luca
Cybernetic Heist.StartDialogue:
Eurasian Brawlers, their sheer strength and aggression make them almost unstoppable at close range...
But what's even more valuable than their raw power is the tech they carry within those hulking bodies.
I need you to get me three components from one of these brawlers, no matter how it happens.
Cybernetic Heist.EndDialogue:
Eurasian Brawlers, their sheer strength and aggression make them almost unstoppable at close range...
But what's even more valuable than their raw power is the tech they carry within those hulking bodies.
I need you to get me three components from one of these brawlers, no matter how it happens.

Immobile Death.Description: The Europans are fond of deploying stationary defensive turrets. Take them out or scavenge one our forces have destroyed; I don't care which. Bring proof.
Immobile Death.Author: Kane
Immobile Death.StartDialogue:
Their reliance on static turrets is almost... quaint, in a way.
I need you to get me a piece of those turrets so that we may study its defensive qualities.
Scavenge one of their destroyed systems or destroy it yourself – just bring back something I can study.
Immobile Death.EndDialogue:
Their reliance on static turrets is almost... quaint, in a way.
I need you to get me a piece of those turrets so that we may study its defensive qualities.
Scavenge one of their destroyed systems or destroy it yourself – just bring back something I can study.

Treasure in the Sky.Description: Europan Drones may be fragile, but they rapidly broadcast the position of their foes to nearby reinforcements. Kill them before they manage to call for help. Bring us three Europan Drone components so we can study their primitive network tech.
Treasure in the Sky.Author: Kane
Treasure in the Sky.StartDialogue:
Those pesky Europan drones – a nuisance in and of themselves.
But what's even more infuriating is how quickly they alert the rest of Europa's forces when one of our units gets taken out.
We need to neutralize this threat before it becomes an overwhelming problem for us.
Get me three components from downed Europan Drones.
Treasure in the Sky.EndDialogue:
Those pesky Europan drones – a nuisance in and of themselves.
But what's even more infuriating is how quickly they alert the rest of Europa's forces when one of our units gets taken out.
We need to neutralize this threat before it becomes an overwhelming problem for us.
Get me three components from downed Europan Drones.

Aerial Scavenge.Description: We aren't sure what Eurasian Drones actually are, but we do know they can be destroyed. Bring me three components from downed Eurasian Drones so we can study them.
Aerial Scavenge.Author: Luca
Aerial Scavenge.StartDialogue:
Eurasian drones are a mystery within themselves.
Their purpose is clear: to destroy anything in their way with ruthless efficiency.
But what are they, really? A mix of machine and... something else?
We need to understand the technology behind these machines if we hope to counter them on our own terms.
Get me three components from downed Eurasian Drones. We'll study them, see what secrets we can uncover.
Aerial Scavenge.EndDialogue:
Eurasian drones are a mystery within themselves.
Their purpose is clear: to destroy anything in their way with ruthless efficiency.
But what are they, really? A mix of machine and... something else?
We need to understand the technology behind these machines if we hope to counter them on our own terms.
Get me three components from downed Eurasian Drones. We'll study them, see what secrets we can uncover.

Harvest Tech.Description: The stories behind Eurasian Crawlers and Cyborgs make me sick. Rumour has it, that its actually wetware in those brain cases! Actual ghosts...in those shells. If we can get 5 components from them, we might be able to learn more.
Harvest Tech.Author: Luca
Harvest Tech.StartDialogue:
You know the abominations they call the Crawlers and Cyborgs – we've heard whispers about what's really inside their metal bodies.
Some say it's just propaganda, but I believe there's truth to those rumors...
Actual wetware in those brain cases! Actual ghosts... in those shells.
I need you to get 5 components from one of these monstrosities. If we can crack the code on how they're integrated...
Harvest Tech.EndDialogue:
You know the abominations they call the Crawlers and Cyborgs – we've heard whispers about what's really inside their metal bodies.
Some say it's just propaganda, but I believe there's truth to those rumors...
Actual wetware in those brain cases! Actual ghosts... in those shells.
I need you to get 5 components from one of these monstrosities. If we can crack the code on how they're integrated...

Defeat the Uplinks.Description: We have postive intel that Europa has deployed Neuro Uplinks in Ashen Mesa. Not only will this hamper our efforts there, these devices are very valuable. Bring us three units.
Defeat the Uplinks.Author: Kane
Defeat the Uplinks.StartDialogue:
Those Europan uplinks – we've heard they're spreading them in Ashen Mesa.
Not just a nuisance for our operations, but those things have value on the black market too.
I need you to get in there and bring me back at least three of these Neuro Uplinks.
Defeat the Uplinks.EndDialogue:
Those Europan uplinks – we've heard they're spreading them in Ashen Mesa.
Not just a nuisance for our operations, but those things have value on the black market too.
I need you to get in there and bring me back at least three of these Neuro Uplinks.

Discover the Truth.Description: We have good intel that Eurasia has fresh battle plans planted in Scrapyard Nexus, awaiting some kind of covert exchange. You have a small window of opportunity. Get to these plans before they do.
Discover the Truth.Author: Luca
Discover the Truth.StartDialogue:
Listen up – we've got word on the down-low.
Those Eurasians are meeting with Euruska's people at the Nexus, and it can't be good for us.
There'll be battle plans floating around somewhere in that mess of scrap metal.
I need you to get there before they exchange hands. Get those plans.
Discover the Truth.EndDialogue:
Listen up – we've got word on the down-low.
Those Eurasians are meeting with Euruska's people at the Nexus, and it can't be good for us.
There'll be battle plans floating around somewhere in that mess of scrap metal.
I need you to get there before they exchange hands. Get those plans.

Objectives.Text: Retrieve Battle Plans in Scrapyard Nexus

Unravel Euruskan Mysteries.Description: Euruska seems to have updated their brigade-level tactics and interoperability with Eurasian Air Forces. Bring us some Euruskan Plans so we can learn more about their evolving capabilities.
Unravel Euruskan Mysteries.Author: Luca
Unravel Euruskan Mysteries.StartDialogue:
We've received reports that our enemies are adapting.
They're getting slicker, working together like a well-oiled machine – especially when it comes to air support from those Eurasians.
I need you to get your hands on some Euruskan plans.
We'll take whatever advantage we can get over our foes in Ashen Mesa and beyond.
Unravel Euruskan Mysteries.EndDialogue:
We've received reports that our enemies are adapting.
They're getting slicker, working together like a well-oiled machine – especially when it comes to air support from those Eurasians.
I need you to get your hands on some Euruskan plans.
We'll take whatever advantage we can get over our foes in Ashen Mesa and beyond.

Risky Cargo.Description: There are often explosive stockpiles in key defensive positions. I know its tempting to destroy these to distract or defeat the combatants up there, but if you bring me two explosives I will reward you handsomely.
Risky Cargo.Author: Luca
Risky Cargo.StartDialogue:
I've got a bit of a delicate situation on my hands.
We have explosive stockpiles in key defensive positions that could be... tempting to take out.
But instead of blowing them all up and causing chaos, I need someone like you to carefully collect two explosives from these areas for me.
Risky Cargo.EndDialogue:
I've got a bit of a delicate situation on my hands.
We have explosive stockpiles in key defensive positions that could be... tempting to take out.
But instead of blowing them all up and causing chaos, I need someone like you to carefully collect two explosives from these areas for me.

Cull the Herd.Description: You didn't hear this from me, but my higher-ups are worried that Eurasia might be gaining the upper hand. If you can destroy 15 of them in a single battle and get back here alive, I'll make it worth your while.
Cull the Herd.Author: Luca
Cull the Herd.StartDialogue:
I'm not supposed to say anything about this.
But... let's just say that there are people within our organization who think Eurasia is becoming too strong.
If you can take out some of their soldiers in one battle and get back here alive, I'll make sure it pays off.
Cull the Herd.EndDialogue:
I'm not supposed to say anything about this.
But... let's just say that there are people within our organization who think Eurasia is becoming too strong.
If you can take out some of their soldiers in one battle and get back here alive, I'll make sure it pays off.

Hostile Expungement.Description: The Europans need to be taught a lesson. Even combatants of your.... stature should be able to easily defeat them. Destroy 15 of them in a single battle and report back here.
Hostile Expungement.Author: Kane
Hostile Expungement.StartDialogue:
We wish to study the average scavenger's combat effectiveness.
As such, we have an exercise for someone like you.
Take on as many Europans as you can handle, destroy at least fifteen of them.
We will watch on with great interest. Good hunting.
Hostile Expungement.EndDialogue:
We wish to study the average scavenger's combat effectiveness.
As such, we have an exercise for someone like you.
Take on as many Europans as you can handle, destroy at least fifteen of them.
We will watch on with great interest. Good hunting.

Mercy Killing.Description: The Eurasian forces have been sending Cyborg conscripts into battle en-masse. Put ten of these poor souls out of their misery (and ours) and come back here for your reward.
Mercy Killing.Author: Luca
Mercy Killing.StartDialogue:
Those Cyborgs are a nightmare to fight against.
Eurasia's been flooding the battlefield with them, and it's getting harder to keep our heads above water.
Take out a group of them, and you'll be doing us a favor.
Mercy Killing.EndDialogue:
Those Cyborgs are a nightmare to fight against.
Eurasia's been flooding the battlefield with them, and it's getting harder to keep our heads above water.
Take out a group of them, and you'll be doing us a favor.

Avenge the Fallen.Description: Eurasian Brawlers have been wiping out Europan forces. As such, I am authorized to reward you for destroying ten of them to thin their numbers.
Avenge the Fallen.Author: Luca
Avenge the Fallen.StartDialogue:
Those Eurasian Brawlers are a plague on our people.
They're running wild and killing off our soldiers with impunity.
Get me proof that you've taken out at least ten of them, and I'll make sure you're rewarded handsomely.
Avenge the Fallen.EndDialogue:
Those Eurasian Brawlers are a plague on our people.
They're running wild and killing off our soldiers with impunity.
Get me proof that you've taken out at least ten of them, and I'll make sure you're rewarded handsomely.

In the Crosshairs.Description: The Europans have foolishly revealed that their newest targeting system technology is being used in Elephant Mausoleum. Bring us one of these intact. Immediately.
In the Crosshairs.Author: Kane
In the Crosshairs.StartDialogue:
Those Europans are so predictable.
They have let slip to the world that they are deploying their new targeting system in Elephant Mausoleum.
Get over there and grab one of those systems for us.
Good hunting.
In the Crosshairs.EndDialogue:
Those Europans are so predictable.
They have let slip to the world that they are deploying their new targeting system in Elephant Mausoleum.
Get over there and grab one of those systems for us.
Good hunting.

Objectives.Text: Retrieve Targeting Systems from Elephant Mausoleum

HIDDEN Unlocked Potental.Description: Frozen Swamp used to be a thriving source of energy production. Retrieve 3 Fuel Refining Plans from there and bring it to us. Perhaps we can learn to be energy sufficient again.

Objectives.Text: Retrieve Refining Plans from Frozen Swamp

HIDDEN The Personal Touch.Description: We are surviving down here, but we are not living. It would be a huge boost to morale if you could find and retrieve 3 Scavenger Personal Items from Shanti and bring them back.

Investigate Ashen Mesa.Description: Ashen Mesa has been a recent hot spot of combat, but we aren't sure why. Get in there, get out alive, and report back here about what you learned.
Investigate Ashen Mesa.Author: Владелец
Investigate Ashen Mesa.StartDialogue:
Ashen Mesa has been a hotspot for conflict lately.
We're not sure what's causing it, but we need to know.
Get in there, gather as much intel as possible, and report back to me.
Investigate Ashen Mesa.EndDialogue:
Ashen Mesa has been a hotspot for conflict lately.
We're not sure what's causing it, but we need to know.
Get in there, gather as much intel as possible, and report back to me.

HIDDEN Cause Distraction in Scrapyard Ne.Description: Scrapyard Nexus is a very risky place to visit. One entry, one exit, and swarming with highly armed combatants. Get in there, see what's going on, and extract to raise the alarm and distract the enemy. Be warned, they will hunt you down when you try to leave.
HIDDEN Cause Distraction in Scrapyard Ne.Author: Владелец
HIDDEN Cause Distraction in Scrapyard Ne.StartDialogue:
Scrapyard Nexus - a high-risk operation if there ever was one.
One entry, one exit, and swarming with enemy combatants.
We need someone to go in, gather intel, and report back here.
But be warned: once you're inside, they'll hunt you down when you try to leave.
HIDDEN Cause Distraction in Scrapyard Ne.EndDialogue:
Scrapyard Nexus - a high-risk operation if there ever was one.
One entry, one exit, and swarming with enemy combatants.
We need someone to go in, gather intel, and report back here.
But be warned: once you're inside, they'll hunt you down when you try to leave.

Elephant Mausoleum Sortie.Description: Elephant Mausoleum is right in our back yard. And it hasn't seen a moments peace for what seems like forever. Get in there and get out and report here about what you witnessed.
Elephant Mausoleum Sortie.Author: Luca
Elephant Mausoleum Sortie.StartDialogue:
Elephant Mausoleum - one of our most strategic locations.
It's been under attack for months, but we need to know the current situation on the ground.
Get inside the mausoleum, gather as much intel as you can, and report back here.
Elephant Mausoleum Sortie.EndDialogue:
Elephant Mausoleum - one of our most strategic locations.
It's been under attack for months, but we need to know the current situation on the ground.
Get inside the mausoleum, gather as much intel as you can, and report back here.

Swamp Probing Mission.Description: Reports are that Frozen Swamp has become a Water Thieves stronghold. Visit this location and return alive to report back about the truth.
Swamp Probing Mission.Author: Владелец
Swamp Probing Mission.StartDialogue:
Our surveillance suggests that the scavs' camp in the Frozen Swamp may be more than just a temporary settlement,
it's possibly the base of operations of the Water Thieves faction, a hub for them to plan against us and Europa alike.
I need you to gather intel on what they're up to in the area, and return here alive to report back to me personally.
Swamp Probing Mission.EndDialogue:
Our surveillance suggests that the scavs' camp in the Frozen Swamp may be more than just a temporary settlement,
it's possibly the base of operations of the Water Thieves faction, a hub for them to plan against us and Europa alike.
I need you to gather intel on what they're up to in the area, and return here alive to report back to me personally.

Scorched Enclave Recon.Description: The Scorched Enclave has an ominous and well deserved name. We need to know who is in current control of the front lines there. Go and get back here alive.

Pyro Revealed.Description: The deadly Pyro has been spotted in Scorched Enclave. Nobody knows who is under that hood, but we do know they have killed countless Eurasians. Bring us proof of Pyro's defeat and we will make it worth your while.
Pyro Revealed.Author: Kane
Pyro Revealed.StartDialogue:
You have heard of the legend, I'm sure.
"Pyro", a masked fighter feared by many in our ranks.
We could find nothing on this character - all personal records have been erased by the nation they used to serve. Assumed military.
Go to Scorched Enclave and destroy the legend.
We look forward to your success.
Pyro Revealed.EndDialogue:
You have heard of the legend, I'm sure.
"Pyro", a masked fighter feared by many in our ranks.
We could find nothing on this character - all personal records have been erased by the nation they used to serve. Assumed military.
Go to Scorched Enclave and destroy the legend.
We look forward to your success.

Objectives.Text: Pyro has been seen in Scorched Enclave. Search and Destroy

HIDDEN Loot Ammo from the Container.Description: Locate the container and scavenge ammo

HIDDEN Deliver Water Supply.Description: Locate the Water Supply and fill it with your water

Lost Cache.Description: Keep this to yourself: I put a valuable data cache in one of the lock-boxes in Elephant Mausoleum, but I don't remember which one. Find it for me.
Lost Cache.Author: Luca
Lost Cache.StartDialogue:
I've got something important hidden away in Elephant Mausoleum.
A valuable data cache that could change the course of this war, if we can just get our hands on it.
The problem is... I'm not sure where I put it.
There are plenty of containers in the Mausoleum, but which one has my data?
Lost Cache.EndDialogue:
I've got something important hidden away in Elephant Mausoleum.
A valuable data cache that could change the course of this war, if we can just get our hands on it.
The problem is... I'm not sure where I put it.
There are plenty of containers in the Mausoleum, but which one has my data?

Objectives.Text: Find a specific Data Cache in Elephant Mausoleum

HIND Nav Comp.Description: Word on the street is that HIND choppers have been seen patrolling Ashen Mesa. If you can get ahold of one of their nav computer motherboards and get it to me I'll make it worth your while.
HIND Nav Comp.Author: Luca
HIND Nav Comp.StartDialogue:
We've got a problem in Ashen Mesa.
Those Eurasian HIND choppers are starting to patrol the area.
I need someone to get me one of those Nav Computer Motherboards from them.
It's not going to be easy, but I'm willing to pay good money for it.
HIND Nav Comp.EndDialogue:
We've got a problem in Ashen Mesa.
Those Eurasian HIND choppers are starting to patrol the area.
I need someone to get me one of those Nav Computer Motherboards from them.
It's not going to be easy, but I'm willing to pay good money for it.

Objectives.Text: Collect a Nav Computer from a HIND in Ashen Mesa

Errand of Mercy.Description: Rex, an EOD commander, took my kid's doll as a trophy after crushing my child's skull. I don't care how you get it, just get it for me and I'll pay you handsomely.
Errand of Mercy.Author: Slade
Errand of Mercy.StartDialogue:
I've got something personal to deal with now.
There was an EOD commander named Rex who took something from me – a reminder of what happened to my child.
It's a teddy bear, but to me, it's more than just a toy.
Get it back for me. I don't care how you do it.
Errand of Mercy.EndDialogue:
I've got something personal to deal with now.
There was an EOD commander named Rex who took something from me – a reminder of what happened to my child.
It's a teddy bear, but to me, it's more than just a toy.
Get it back for me. I don't care how you do it.

Hidden Water Pt 1.Description: Gathering water as you find it is all fine and good, but I have good info suggesting a map pointing to a huge source of water is in Ashen Mesa. Bring it to be and I'll decode it
Hidden Water Pt 1.Author: Slade
Hidden Water Pt 1.StartDialogue:
Water's hard to come by these days, especially since the war started.
But I've got a tip that might change everything.
There's supposed to be a map hidden somewhere in Ashen Mesa.
It points to a large of water, enough to supply us for weeks.
Find that map and bring it back here.
Hidden Water Pt 1.EndDialogue:
Water's hard to come by these days, especially since the war started.
But I've got a tip that might change everything.
There's supposed to be a map hidden somewhere in Ashen Mesa.
It points to a large of water, enough to supply us for weeks.
Find that map and bring it back here.

Objectives.Text: Collect Map for Water in Ashen Mesa

Hidden Water Pt 2.Description: That map you found was gold. There is a trove of water in Elephant. Bring it to us and we can fill these tanks.
Hidden Water Pt 2.Author: Slade
Hidden Water Pt 2.StartDialogue:
You managed to get your hands on the map, and now we know where that large source of water is.
It's in Elephant Mausoleum – who would have thought?
Get to the location marked on the map, bring back as much water as you can carry.
Hidden Water Pt 2.EndDialogue:
You managed to get your hands on the map, and now we know where that large source of water is.
It's in Elephant Mausoleum – who would have thought?
Get to the location marked on the map, bring back as much water as you can carry.

Connecting the Dots.Description: Its rumored that at the very back of the Scrapyard a control panel is still active. Its not 100% clear what it does, but if used SOMETHING is supposed to happen in Scorched Enclave. See if you can figure it out
Connecting the Dots.Author: Slade
Connecting the Dots.StartDialogue:
There's talk of an old control panel hidden somewhere deep in the Nexus.
Not a lot of people know about it, and even less have tried to find it.
But supposedly, it has some kind of connection to what happens in Scorched Enclave.
Get to the back of the Scrapyard and see if you can find out what this thing does.
Connecting the Dots.EndDialogue:
There's talk of an old control panel hidden somewhere deep in the Nexus.
Not a lot of people know about it, and even less have tried to find it.
But supposedly, it has some kind of connection to what happens in Scorched Enclave.
Get to the back of the Scrapyard and see if you can find out what this thing does.

Objectives.Text: Activate Control Panel in Scrapyard Nexus

Summon the Pain Pt 1.Description: There is a delivery of highly valuable goods coming to Scrapyard Nexus. The only way we can get at it and hope to live is if we cause a distraction. If you destroy 20 Eurasians they are bound to blame Europa and attack the Scrapyard.
Summon the Pain Pt 1.Author: Slade
Summon the Pain Pt 1.StartDialogue:
We've got a chance to get what we need, but it's going to require some effort.
There's a shipment coming into Nexus, something that'll really help us out.
But we can't just waltz in – there are too many eyes on the place.
I need you to create a diversion. Take out 20 of those Eurasians and make them think Europa is behind it.
Summon the Pain Pt 1.EndDialogue:
We've got a chance to get what we need, but it's going to require some effort.
There's a shipment coming into Nexus, something that'll really help us out.
But we can't just waltz in – there are too many eyes on the place.
I need you to create a diversion. Take out 20 of those Eurasians and make them think Europa is behind it.

Summon the Pain Pt 2.Description: You did it. Now Eurasia is going to counter-attack in the scrapyard. That should buy you time to collect the crates and get out of there
Summon the Pain Pt 2.Author: Slade
Summon the Pain Pt 2.StartDialogue:
It's done. You created enough chaos for us.
Now Eurasia will be too busy fighting off Europa's retaliation to bother with us.
That gives us a small window – make use of it, get in and grab what crates you can.
Summon the Pain Pt 2.EndDialogue:
It's done. You created enough chaos for us.
Now Eurasia will be too busy fighting off Europa's retaliation to bother with us.
That gives us a small window – make use of it, get in and grab what crates you can.

Mech Wreck.Description: I noticed a Europan Medium Mech was destroyed in your last battle. I happen to know that pilot escaped and is in hiding in Elephant Mausoleum. Find them and finish the job: take the bastard out.
Mech Wreck.Author: Владелец
Mech Wreck.StartDialogue:
That Europan pilot thought she was so lucky, didn't she?
Managed to get away from us when her mech got destroyed.
Well, I've got a message for her: not today.
Find that pilot in Elephant Mausoleum and put an end to her life.
Mech Wreck.EndDialogue:
That Europan pilot thought she was so lucky, didn't she?
Managed to get away from us when her mech got destroyed.
Well, I've got a message for her: not today.
Find that pilot in Elephant Mausoleum and put an end to her life.

Memento Pt 1.Description: I used to work in Ashen Mesa. I lost my partner when we had to evacuate. If you get a chance & if you find it, I'd love to have a picture of them to remember them by. I know I left one around there somewhere
Memento Pt 1.Author: Slade
Memento Pt 1.StartDialogue:
Listen... about the Mesa.
I used to work here with my partner.
We got out just in time – but she didn't make it.
If you happen across her photo while you're scavenging...
Get it for me, would you? It'd mean a lot.
Memento Pt 1.EndDialogue:
Listen... about the Mesa.
I used to work here with my partner.
We got out just in time – but she didn't make it.
If you happen across her photo while you're scavenging...
Get it for me, would you? It'd mean a lot.

Objectives.Text: Bring the Picture from Ashen Mesa

Memento Pt 2.Description: Thank you so much for finding my picture. It was taken at what we now call Scorched Enclave. I notice in the pic that there used to be a weapon facility there. There might still be vaiuable tech to collect if you find it.
Memento Pt 2.Author: Slade
Memento Pt 2.StartDialogue:
You got me the photo... and yeah, I see where it was taken.
Scorched Enclave – what's left of it.
I remember when that place had a real facility for producing gear.
If you can find any useful tech still lying around, bring it back to us. We could use the upgrade.
Memento Pt 2.EndDialogue:
You got me the photo... and yeah, I see where it was taken.
Scorched Enclave – what's left of it.
I remember when that place had a real facility for producing gear.
If you can find any useful tech still lying around, bring it back to us. We could use the upgrade.

Objectives.Text: Collect Weapon Tech in Scorched Enclave

Memento Pt 3.Description: That tech you found really made a difference. I'm using it to assemble something that might give us a chance to live. I'm almost done. If you get me some of the precision components from the surgical areas I can finish
Memento Pt 3.Author: Slade
Memento Pt 3.StartDialogue:
You got us some useful gear from the enclave.
We've been tinkering with it, trying to make something out of this mess.
I need one more thing: those precision components from the Mausoleum's surgical areas.
Get me what you can – I think I'm close to finishing whatever it is I'm building.
Memento Pt 3.EndDialogue:
You got us some useful gear from the enclave.
We've been tinkering with it, trying to make something out of this mess.
I need one more thing: those precision components from the Mausoleum's surgical areas.
Get me what you can – I think I'm close to finishing whatever it is I'm building.

Objectives.Text: Collect the Precision Components from Elephant Mausoleum

Insignia Retrieval.Description: Elite Brawlers are now guarding Scrapyard Nexus. Collect their insignias and I'll reward you generously.
Insignia Retrieval.Author: Luca
Insignia Retrieval.StartDialogue:
Those Brawlers have been upgraded.
Now they're guarding Scrapyard Nexus.
Get me those insignias off them – all three of the new Elite Brawlers.
I'll make sure you get a good reward for this.
Insignia Retrieval.EndDialogue:
Those Brawlers have been upgraded.
Now they're guarding Scrapyard Nexus.
Get me those insignias off them – all three of the new Elite Brawlers.
I'll make sure you get a good reward for this.

Enclave Strike.Description: A team of Assaulters is tearing through our forces at the Enclave. Defeat all three to prove your valor.
Enclave Strike.Author: Luca
Enclave Strike.StartDialogue:
We've got a problem in the Enclave.
Those Eurasian Assaulters are cutting through our lines like they're nothing.
I need you to take them down – all three of them.
Prove yourself by defeating those bloodthirsty killers.
Enclave Strike.EndDialogue:
We've got a problem in the Enclave.
Those Eurasian Assaulters are cutting through our lines like they're nothing.
I need you to take them down – all three of them.
Prove yourself by defeating those bloodthirsty killers.

Armor Harvest.Description: Up for a challenge against armored soldiers with auto-shotguns? Some of them have just made their way to Elephant Mausoleum. Eliminate them and bring me their armor shards, and you’ll receive a juicy reward.
Armor Harvest.Author: Kane
Armor Harvest.StartDialogue:
We think you are the right contractor for this next task...
... hunting armored Europan soldiers in the Mausoleum.
They run with auto-shotguns and sport advanced combat armor.
Not an easy task, but I've been cleared to reward handsomely if you can bring me their armor shards.
Armor Harvest.EndDialogue:
We think you are the right contractor for this next task...
... hunting armored Europan soldiers in the Mausoleum.
They run with auto-shotguns and sport advanced combat armor.
Not an easy task, but I've been cleared to reward handsomely if you can bring me their armor shards.

Objectives.Text: Collect 3 Armor Shards from Heavy Shotgunners

Trooper Disillusion.Description: Europa trusts that their EOD troopers' armor will keep them alive. Demonstrate their mistake neutralize 3 of these troopers.
Trooper Disillusion.Author: Kane
Trooper Disillusion.StartDialogue:
These new Europan LMG units sport some ridiculously heavy looking armour.
We need to know if this development is something to be concerned about.
We wish to probe their armour's performance... Kinetically.
As such, please conduct a terminal test on three of those LMG troopers for us.
For this test to succeed - none of the test subjects must be alive at the end.
Trooper Disillusion.EndDialogue:
These new Europan LMG units sport some ridiculously heavy looking armour.
We need to know if this development is something to be concerned about.
We wish to probe their armour's performance... Kinetically.
As such, please conduct a terminal test on three of those LMG troopers for us.
For this test to succeed - none of the test subjects must be alive at the end.

Sniper Sweep.Description: A cunning Eurasian sharpshooter is picking off our soldiers from his perch in Ashen Mesa. Bring me that bastard's equipment!
Sniper Sweep.Author: Luca
Sniper Sweep.StartDialogue:
We've got a problem on our hands.
One of those Eurasians has managed to find the perfect spot to pick us off.
He's been taking out our soldiers with ease, and it's time we put an end to this.
Get us the specialized equipment he carries. We can use its technology for ourselves.
Track him down in Ashen Mesa, take his gear.
Sniper Sweep.EndDialogue:

Track him down in Ashen Mesa, take his gear.

Objectives.Text: Collect the custom euqipmnet carried by the God Sniper in Ashen Mesa

HIDDEN Pheromone Harvest.Description: Have you come across the creatures we refer to as grabbers? We've located a pregnant specimen in the Elephant Mausoleum. Please procure her pheromone sac for our research.
HIDDEN Pheromone Harvest.Author: Luca
HIDDEN Pheromone Harvest.StartDialogue:
We have reason to believe there's a pregnant Grabber in the Mausoleum.
Those creatures are useful for study – especially with their unique... "biology".
Get us that pheromone sac from her. We need it for our research.
HIDDEN Pheromone Harvest.EndDialogue:
We have reason to believe there's a pregnant Grabber in the Mausoleum.
Those creatures are useful for study – especially with their unique... "biology".
Get us that pheromone sac from her. We need it for our research.

Objectives.Text: Collect the Pheromones Sac from the Pregnant Grabber in Elephant Mausoleum

HIDDEN AA Tech Extraction.Description: Air dominance over the Mesa has been compromised. We need to investigate the tech Europa deploys against our HINDs. Obtain a targeting computer from their anti-aircraft systems and bring it here.
HIDDEN AA Tech Extraction.Author: Владелец
HIDDEN AA Tech Extraction.StartDialogue:
We've got a problem on our hands – air superiority is slipping.
Those Europans have some new tricks up their sleeve, taking down our HINDs with ease.
We need to know how they're doing it.
Get your hands on one of those targeting computers from their anti-air systems.
Bring it back here and we'll figure out a way to counter them.
HIDDEN AA Tech Extraction.EndDialogue:
We've got a problem on our hands – air superiority is slipping.
Those Europans have some new tricks up their sleeve, taking down our HINDs with ease.
We need to know how they're doing it.
Get your hands on one of those targeting computers from their anti-air systems.
Bring it back here and we'll figure out a way to counter them.

Objectives.Text: Collect the Targeting Computer from an Anti-Air system  in Ashen Mesa

Red Baron's Legacy.Description: The Europans venerate an old exo referred to as Red Baron. Humble them by taking the banner in his possession.
Red Baron's Legacy.Author: Kane
Red Baron's Legacy.StartDialogue:
We know how much those Europans love their symbols of power.
Psyops wants to conduct an operation on that veteran Exo, battlefield designation: Red Baron.
Do not be concerned by appearances - it is a mere Europan war relic with some inflated stories attached to it.
We need you to retrieve the idolised banner in its possession. Humble them.
Red Baron's Legacy.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Collect the Banner from the Red Baron in Elephant Mausoleum

Shadow Sweep.Description: Europans have initiated a covert strike on Nexus. Cloaked assassins are targeting our forces. Eliminate them before they eliminate us.
Shadow Sweep.Author: Kane
Shadow Sweep.StartDialogue:
You know how these Europans love playing childish games.
Well, this time they've inserted a covert fighting force of unknown number, into Scrapyard Nexus.
These cloaked Europan units are diminishing our local troop morale. We will not stand for this.
Get rid of them – all of them.
Shadow Sweep.EndDialogue:
You know how these Europans love playing childish games.
Well, this time they've inserted a covert fighting force of unknown number, into Scrapyard Nexus.
These cloaked Europan units are diminishing our local troop morale. We will not stand for this.
Get rid of them – all of them.

Target Locked.Description: Intel reports a Euruskan commander's presence within the Scorched Enclave. Your objective: eliminate the motherfucker. But be cautious of his bodyguard, a heavily armored Mech dubbed Toothy.
Target Locked.Author: Luca
Target Locked.StartDialogue:
Listen up – we have a target.
Euruska's got one of their top brass hiding in Scorched Enclave.
He's a commander of the 4th Euruskan Division.
We need you to take him out. Permanently.
Be careful – he's got Toothy with him, that hulking monstrosity.
Target Locked.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Eliminate the Euruska Commander in Scorched Enclave

HIDDEN Support the Scavs.Description: Welcome to the Innards. Look, we need more water, plain and simple. Tell you what, if you can recon any region for us and report back maybe that will help us find some water. I'll also dip into my personal stash of water if you do this.
HIDDEN Support the Scavs.Author: Slade
HIDDEN Support the Scavs.StartDialogue:
Welcome to the Innards. Look, we need more water, plain and simple. 
Tell you what, if you can recon a region for us and report back maybe that will help us find some water. 
I'll dip into my personal stash of water if you do this.

HIDDEN Rigged for Looting.Description: Welcome back. Now that we know you can survive in the field, bring us 1 more barrel of water from anywhere. This water will do us a lot of good. Tell you what, I will give you a better rig to carry items & damaged / destroyed weaponry if you do this for us.
HIDDEN Rigged for Looting.Author: Slade
HIDDEN Rigged for Looting.StartDialogue:
Now that we know you can survive in the field, bring us 1 more barrel of water from anywhere.
Water is vital. We are constantly using it, so we also need to constantly resupply it.
The more water the Innards has, the more people will be attracted here, providing more opportunities for gear and quests.
Water and other supplies take a lot of space in your rig and I know more carry capacity would be valuable to you.
I will give you a better rig to carry items & damaged / destroyed weaponry if you do this for us.

Objectives.Text: Bring 1 Barrel of Water back to the Innards

HIDDEN Friends in Hostile Places.Description: Looks like you can handle yourself. Tell you what, I'm willing to introduce you to my Eurasian and Euruskan counterparts, but you'll have to prove yourself to them first. If you can get ahold of three Europan Drone components that should be enough to convince them you are worth their time
HIDDEN Friends in Hostile Places.Author: Slade
HIDDEN Friends in Hostile Places.StartDialogue:
I gotta tell ya, it sure looks like you can handle yourself.
Tell you what, I'm willing to introduce you to my Eurasian and Euruskan counterparts, but you'll have to prove yourself to them first.
If you can get ahold of three Europan Drone components that should be enough to convince them you are worth their time
Come back to me when you have the components and I'll hook you up.
Oh, and I'll also make it worth your while.
HIDDEN Friends in Hostile Places.EndDialogue:

HIDDEN Poke with a Bigger Stick.Description: It seems you think yourself competent. Or at least that's what I have been told. Tell you what, if you manage to destroy, say, ten Europans out there for us and come back alive I'll give you something to replace that garbage you call a weapon. Or you can purchase one from our vendor of course. Oh, I'll also throw in some water. Do this for us and we can open up all sorts of job opportunities for you.
HIDDEN Poke with a Bigger Stick.Author: Kane
HIDDEN Poke with a Bigger Stick.StartDialogue:
It seems you think yourself competent. Or at least that's what I have been told.

You can of course purchase one from our vendor. Oh, I'll also throw in some water.
Do this for us and we can open up all sorts of job opportunities for you.

HIDDEN Staunch the Bleeding.Description: I'll be blunt so neither of our time is wasted: I think I can make use of you. If you can get us four bandages that will keep some of my commrades alive for a bit longer. They can be found in many places. Do this and I'll give you water and some upgrades for that.... rig you use to haul items.
HIDDEN Staunch the Bleeding.Author: Владелец
HIDDEN Staunch the Bleeding.StartDialogue:
I'll be blunt so neither of our time is wasted: I think I can make use of you.
If you can get us five bandages that will keep some of my commrades alive for a bit longer.
They can be found in many places.
Do this and I'll give you water and some upgrades for that.... rig you use to haul items.
HIDDEN Staunch the Bleeding.EndDialogue:

HIDDEN Time to Fly.Description: I guess you've met most everyone. Do us one last task and I'll connect you to the Europans for more quests: get into Ashen Mesa and learn what you can. Extract alive and the Europan quest giver should be available. I may also have more work for you as well.
HIDDEN Time to Fly.Author: Slade
HIDDEN Time to Fly.StartDialogue:
I hope you have met most everyone.
Do us one last task and I'll connect you to the Europans for more quests.
Go to Ashen Mesa and learn what you can. Extract alive and I'll make sure Europan quest is available. 
I may also have more work for you as well.
HIDDEN Time to Fly.EndDialogue:

Do us one last task and I'll connect you to the Europans for more quests.
Go to Ashen Mesa and learn what you can. Extract alive and I'll make sure Europan quest is available. 
I may also have more work for you as well.

Terror on Display.Description: There is word that the Europans sometimes cover their vehicles with what we assume are enemy soldiers, but they may be any hapless fool that gets in their way. If you ever find one of these Corpse-Tanks destroyed (either by their foes or your own hand) please collect its CorpseTank Control Panel and bring it here so we can identify its victims.
Terror on Display.Author: Slade
Terror on Display.StartDialogue:
Word is, those Europans love playing dirty.
They'll use any poor soul they can find to camouflage their vehicles – just throw them on top like a coat of paint.
If you happen across one of those Corpse-Tanks when it's been taken out...
Get the control panel off it. We need to know who we're dealing with in there.
Terror on Display.EndDialogue:
Word is, those Europans love playing dirty.
They'll use any poor soul they can find to camouflage their vehicles – just throw them on top like a coat of paint.
If you happen across one of those Corpse-Tanks when it's been taken out...
Get the control panel off it. We need to know who we're dealing with in there.

Objectives.Text: Collect one Corpse Tank Control Panel

Bring Her In.Description: Some of the Exo pilots are sympathetic to our cause. If you happen to see one once their Exo is destroyed, pick her up, and bring her back here. She might have intel on their movements, plans—anything useful. Get her back here safely.
Bring Her In.Author: Slade
Bring Her In.StartDialogue:
You know how we Scavs operate – always on the move.
We've got some allies in the Exo pilots, but they're hard to trust.
If one of their Exos gets taken out, there's a chance she might be willing to help us.
Keep an eye out for her, bring her back to our base – we'll take care of the rest.
Bring Her In.EndDialogue:
You know how we Scavs operate – always on the move.
We've got some allies in the Exo pilots, but they're hard to trust.
If one of their Exos gets taken out, there's a chance she might be willing to help us.
Keep an eye out for her, bring her back to our base – we'll take care of the rest.

Objectives.Text: Save, Collect, and Extract with Exo Pilot

Med Bay Access.Description: Europa's stashed medical supplies in their trench med bay. We need you to get in there and crack that door open, but their security's no joke. Think you can hack their system? You help us, and we'll make sure you're stocked up too.
Med Bay Access.Author: Владелец
Med Bay Access.StartDialogue:
Listen, I've got a proposition for you.
You know how Europa believes in their hack-proof security? We don't.
And I happen to know that you can crack their med bay's system – and get us medical supplies we need.
Can't have our people dying on the battlefield without basic aid.
Hack the system, open that door – and I'll make sure your pockets are full.
Med Bay Access.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Hack the Locked Gate in the Medical Trenches of Elephant Mausoleum

Tormentor\u2019s Trail.Description: Our recent actions had provoked Europans, and now they’ve sent their deadliest tormentor to hunt us down in Ashen Mesa. Stop him before he wipes us all out.
Tormentor\u2019s Trail.Author: Владелец
Tormentor\u2019s Trail.StartDialogue:
You're the only one I can trust with this.
We've stirred up a hornet's nest, and it's coming for us now.
That Europan monstrosity is heading straight for Ashen Mesa.
Stop him before he reaches our settlements.
Do whatever it takes – I don't care how dirty you get.
Tormentor\u2019s Trail.EndDialogue:
You're the only one I can trust with this.
We've stirred up a hornet's nest, and it's coming for us now.
That Europan monstrosity is heading straight for Ashen Mesa.
Stop him before he reaches our settlements.
Do whatever it takes – I don't care how dirty you get.

Objectives.Text: Stop the Tormentor in Ashen Mesa

Food Chain Interrupted.Description: Scav, one of our... 'recyclers' has malfunctioned beneath the infirmary. The grinder is down, and with it, a significant portion of our food production. We need you to deliver some critical mechanical components to get it back online. And don't think about trying to scavenge anything else - we have eyes on you.
Food Chain Interrupted.Author: Luca
Food Chain Interrupted.StartDialogue:
We need your kind in the Mech Trenches today.
The grinder's down, you know what that means for our people?
Hunger, desperation, potential uprising.
I need you to get these replacement components to the grinder room below the infirmary.
Critical stuff – don't even think about trying to scavenge it for yourself.
Food Chain Interrupted.EndDialogue:
We need your kind in the Mech Trenches today.
The grinder's down, you know what that means for our people?
Hunger, desperation, potential uprising.
I need you to get these replacement components to the grinder room below the infirmary.
Critical stuff – don't even think about trying to scavenge it for yourself.

Objectives.Text: Deliver a Spare Part to the Grinder in Mech Trenches

Plug Pull.Description: We've got intel that a high-ranking officer is being held captive by those Europan pigs. We believe they're trying to extract valuable information from him using their medical tech. I need you to sneak into the infirmary and unplug the life support. Let nature take its course.
Plug Pull.Author: Владелец
Plug Pull.StartDialogue:
Scav, we need someone with your... particular set of skills.
Intel suggests that a high-ranking Euruskan officer has been taken prisoner by Europa.
They're not just holding him for ransom or leverage.
No, these Europan pigs are going to try and extract every last secret from his head.
I want you to get into the infirmary undetected... unplug that life support system...
Let nature take its course. The fewer questions asked about what happened, the better.
Plug Pull.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Unplug the Life Support Systems in Mech Trenches

Flames of Disruption.Description: Scav, Europa is repairing one of their mechs in the Mech Trenches' hangar. I need you to infiltrate and sabotage their efforts. We can't afford to let that mech reach the motor pool in Elephant Mausoleum, where it could tip the balance in their favor.
Flames of Disruption.Author: Владелец
Flames of Disruption.StartDialogue:
This is a high-stakes operation.
I've received intel that Europa's busy repairing one of those deadly mechs down at Mech Trenches' hangar...
If they manage to get it into working condition and send it off to Elephant Mausoleum...
we can kiss our chances goodbye for taking control of the motor pool.
You need to infiltrate their facility, sabotage their repair efforts, and make sure that mech never leaves.
Flames of Disruption.EndDialogue:

You need to infiltrate their facility, sabotage their repair efforts, and make sure that mech never leaves.

Objectives.Text: Sabotage the Mech in the Hangar in Mech Trenches

Data Heist.Description: Scav, I need you to infiltrate the server room in the Mech Trenches, gain access to their network and come back to me. We're looking for intel on their battle plans, patrol routes, and any other information that can give us an edge over Europa. You know what this means - get in, get out, don't leave a trail.
Data Heist.Author: Владелец
Data Heist.StartDialogue:
Listen up, Scav - I need to trust someone with something important.
I'm talking about getting into the server room of Mech Trenches and siphoning off as much intel as possible and come back to me with the data.
Patrol routes, battle plans, anything else... it's all fair game.
This is not going to be an easy task.
Those Europan pigs have got eyes everywhere in those trenches, but we can't let that stop us from finding out what they're up to.
Data Heist.EndDialogue:
Listen up, Scav - I need to trust someone with something important.

Objectives.Text: Hack the Servers and Extract from Mech Trenches

Mechanical Momentum.Description: Scav, we've got a high-priority repair job cooking at Mech Trenches' hangar, with one of those mechs slated to ship out to Scorched Enclave soon. I need you to scavenge some vital mechanical parts from one of the wrecked mechs in the area, and get them into position in the cart near our own mech in the hangar. Get it done and keep a low profile about it.
Mechanical Momentum.Author: Luca
Mechanical Momentum.StartDialogue:
We're on the cusp of sending out one of those mechs to Scorched Enclave, but there's been an unexpected development.
One of our own mechs is getting a high-priority repair job and we need it up and running ASAP.
I'm talking about scavenging some vital mechanical parts from one of the wrecked mechs in the area.
We can't risk anyone noticing what's really happening here, so keep a low profile and stay hidden while you do your job.
Get those parts to our own mech's cart in the hangar where it's being repaired... without raising any suspicion.
Mechanical Momentum.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Deliver Mech Components to the Hangar in Mech Trenches

Tech Theft Prevention.Description: Euruska's been stripping our mechs of valuable tech. I need you to get into their territory and plant some explosives on that mech. When it blows, the Eurasians won't be able to recover any useful parts from it. Make sure they don't get their hands on our tech.
Tech Theft Prevention.Author: Luca
Tech Theft Prevention.StartDialogue:
Euruska's been raking in all sorts of valuable tech from us – and we need you to put a stop to that.
We've got intel suggesting one of those mechs is being taken apart deep in Scrapyard Nexus.
Get inside, plant some explosives on it...
And when the mech goes up in flames, they won't be able to recover anything useful from it.
Tech Theft Prevention.EndDialogue:
Euruska's been raking in all sorts of valuable tech from us – and we need you to put a stop to that.
We've got intel suggesting one of those mechs is being taken apart deep in Scrapyard Nexus.
Get inside, plant some explosives on it...
And when the mech goes up in flames, they won't be able to recover anything useful from it.

Objectives.Text: Plant Explosives on the Mech in Scrapyard Nexus

A Light in the Dark.Description: One of our wounded soldiers needs cigarettes in the med bay at Elephant Mausoleum's infirmary. Scavenge some from fallen troops and bring them back personally. It'll mean a lot to him.

Objectives.Text: Bring Cigarettes to our Wounded Soldier in Elephant Mausoleum

Icon at Stake.Description: We've hidden the Totem in Scrapyard Nexus for safekeeping, but Euruska is closing in. I need you to get there ASAP, retrieve the Totem, and bring it back before they can grab it. Our people's symbol of strength depends on it.
Icon at Stake.Author: Luca
Icon at Stake.StartDialogue:
We've managed to stash our most precious artifact, the Totem, deep within the Nexus for safekeeping,
at least we thought so until I received word that those treacherous Euruskan agents have caught wind of its location.
We need you to get in there and retrieve it before they can lay their hands on it.
This is more than just an artifact, Scav - it's a symbol of our people's strength and resilience.
Don't let them take it from us.
Icon at Stake.EndDialogue:
We've managed to stash our most precious artifact, the Totem, deep within the Nexus for safekeeping,
at least we thought so until I received word that those treacherous Euruskan agents have caught wind of its location.
We need you to get in there and retrieve it before they can lay their hands on it.
This is more than just an artifact, Scav - it's a symbol of our people's strength and resilience.
Don't let them take it from us.

Objectives.Text: Find the Totem and Extract from Scrapyard Nexus

The People's Icon.Description: I need you to infiltrate Scrapyard Nexus and extract the Totem - our sacred artifact that gives us an edge over Europa. Get it back before they can secure it further.
The People's Icon.Author: Владелец
The People's Icon.StartDialogue:
We've got intel that those Europan pigs stashed our revered Totem deep within Scrapyard Nexus.
I need you to infiltrate the area, locate the artifact, and get it out before they can secure it further.
Once we have the Totem back in our possession,
it'll give us a psychological blow against Europa that could pay dividends on the battlefield.
Get this done quietly, without alerting their patrols.

Objectives.Text: Find the Totem and Extract from Scrapyard Nexus

HIDDEN Payback.Description: Goldbrick the sniper owes me. Personally. And he is nowhere to be seen. If you neutralize him I can't pay you much, but you can keep what he's carrying. He uses a 36M AntiTank rifle that you should be able to use yourself if you extract with it, so make sure you have a rig that can carry discarded weaponry!
HIDDEN Payback.Author: Владелец
HIDDEN Payback.StartDialogue:
Listen. This one is personal.
A sniper in our forces named GoldBrick owes me. A lot.
GoldBrick has gone AWOL and we don't think he's coming back.
We think he is in Ashen, but he could be anywhere.
I can't give you much, but if you can take him out and report back to me I'll do what I can.
Oh, and he carries a 36M AntiTank rifle. Feel free to take it if you drop him.
If you extract with his 36M AntiTank I will service it and you can use it in the field, assuming you are trained for such a weapon
So don't forget to bring a rig that can carry discarded weapons!

Thief in the Night.Description: A Europan officer keeps stealing prized alcohol from my shipments. I don't care how you get it back, but if you find him he should have it on him. You'll only be able to do this for me once, so thanks in advance.
Thief in the Night.Author: Slade
Thief in the Night.StartDialogue:
A Europan officer keeps stealing prized alcohol from my shipments.
I don't care how you get it back, but if you find him he should have it on him.
The bastard usually hangs out in Mech Trenches, but he might be in other locations.
Its gonna be tempting to drink or sell the stuff when you get it, but bring it back to me and I'll make it worth your time.
You'll only be able to do this for me once, so thanks in advance.

Whispers Beneath the Thunder.Description: Break into Elephant Mausoleum's hangar and extract the civilians. Get in there now and get those civvies out before it's too late.

Objectives.Text: Help Civilians Escape in Elephant Mausoleum's Hangar

HIDDEN Liberate the Innards.Description: Thieves have taken over the Innards, eliminate them.

HIDDEN Extract from the Innards.Description: You took out the thieves, time to extract.

Tunnel Vision.Description: Slip undetected into the flooded depths of the Underground Cemetery and extract without alerting either side.
Tunnel Vision.Author: Slade
Tunnel Vision.StartDialogue:
I've got a job for you that's gonna test your skills.
Rumors are circulating about Euruska having taken control of the Underground Cemetery.
Slip into the tunnels undetected, avoid any patrols,
and bring back as much intel as you can without triggering a firefight.
Tunnel Vision.EndDialogue:
I've got a job for you that's gonna test your skills.
Rumors are circulating about Euruska having taken control of the Underground Cemetery.
Slip into the tunnels undetected, avoid any patrols,
and bring back as much intel as you can without triggering a firefight.

Freed from Shadows.Description: Sneak into the Undergound Cemetery and liberate the caged scavengers. Be wary of the warring factions.
Freed from Shadows.Author: Slade
Freed from Shadows.StartDialogue:
We got a serious problem on our hands.
Some of us Scavs are being kept locked down in the Underground Cemetery.
I want you to slip in quietly and get those folks outta there.
Act with caution. We don't want our own people caught up in the crossfire.
Freed from Shadows.EndDialogue:
We got a serious problem on our hands.
Some of us Scavs are being kept locked down in the Underground Cemetery.
I want you to slip in quietly and get those folks outta there.
Act with caution. We don't want our own people caught up in the crossfire.

Objectives.Text: Help Civilians Escape from Underground Cemetery

Burying Secrets.Description: Head to the cemetery to collect the logbook of a departed scout, but be careful not to awaken Euruskan grabbers.
Burying Secrets.Author: Slade
Burying Secrets.StartDialogue:
I got word from an old Scav that there's a logbook one our scouts had been keeping before she passed on.
It might hold some valuable intel about the warring factions and their plans for us.
Problem is, it's kept in a shrine near her remains... and I hear Euruskan grabbers patrol that area.
Find that logbook and bring it back to us.
Burying Secrets.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Collect the Logbook from Underground Cemetery

Alpha Threat.Description: Reports from Europa's underground scouts indicate a surge in Scramblers sighted in the flooded tunnels of Underground Cemetery. Neutralizing their handlers is a top priority.
Alpha Threat.Author: Luca
Alpha Threat.StartDialogue:
We have intelligence that indicates an uptick in activity by those 'Scramblers'.
These cybernetic monstrosities are being deployed deep within the Underground Cemetery's flooded tunnels and roadways.
We suspect their handlers to be nearby as well.
Your mission is clear: neutralize these cyborg soldiers' control units and you'll be well rewarded.
Alpha Threat.EndDialogue:

We suspect their handlers to be nearby as well.
Your mission is clear: neutralize these cyborg soldiers' control units and you'll be well rewarded.

Objectives.Text: Eliminate Eurasian Cyborg Pack Leaders in Underground Cemetery

Lost Signals.Description: The sewers hold our fallen comrades. Retrieve their communication devices before they're scavenged by a rival faction.
Lost Signals.Author: Владелец
Lost Signals.StartDialogue:
I've received orders from High Command to recover the comms units
from our fallen comrades in the sewers beneath the city.
Their bodies hold secrets - codes, frequencies, tactical plans... that could give us a strategic edge.
Recover as many of these units as possible before they're scavenged
by those wretched Scavs or worse - by the Europan enemy.
Lost Signals.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Collect Communication Devices from Underground Cemetery

Rust in Peace.Description: Reports confirm a Europan exo patrolling the flooded tunnels of the Underground Cemetery. Neutralize it to prevent escalation and secure the site.
Rust in Peace.Author: Владелец
Rust in Peace.StartDialogue:
We've received word that Europa's deployed an Exoskeleton unit into our territory undergound.
This is a tactical mistake on their part, but one we must capitalize upon.
Ensure the destruction of that Europan Exo.
The security of the site must be maintained, Euruskan interests depend on it.
Rust in Peace.EndDialogue:

Ensure the destruction of that Europan Exo.

Objectives.Text: Destroy the Europan Exo in Underground Cemetery

Shifting Tide.Description: A Water Thief has been captured while spying on the Scorched Enclave's bunkers. Locate him and facilitate a covert extraction before he can be interrogated or worse.
Shifting Tide.Author: Slade
Shifting Tide.StartDialogue:
We've just got word that one of our... acquaintances, 'Caspian', from the Water Thieves clan got caught in Scorched Enclave.
They've been holding him prisoner in a secure bunker.
He may be willing to cooperate with us if given an opportunity to escape.
Shifting Tide.EndDialogue:
We've just got word that one of our... acquaintances, 'Caspian', from the Water Thieves clan got caught in Scorched Enclave.
They've been holding him prisoner in a secure bunker.
He may be willing to cooperate with us if given an opportunity to escape.

Objectives.Text: Help the Water Thief Escape in Scorched Enclave

King of Kings.Description: A hijacked Medium Mech dubbed the "Rat King" is causing havoc. Collect residue from its victims and bring it back for study.
King of Kings.Author: Slade
King of Kings.StartDialogue:
I will get right to the point.
A hijacked Medium Mech is out there.
We call it the "Rat King". You will know it when you see it.
Almost everything it defeats usually drops or has remnants of a residue on it.
If you collect us enough of this residue we will have two things.
First, proof that a hijacked Medium Mech has a chance to bring Scavs hope.
Second, a new residue to investigate to see why it occurs and what use it may have in the future.
Come back here when you have collected enough residue.
King of Kings.EndDialogue:

Manufactured Heist.Description: Scavenge blueprints for advanced firearms in the overgrown north-eastern Titan wreck in the Frozen Swamp. Data storage disks are scattered within the dark, sunken hull of this behemoth.
Manufactured Heist.Author: Kane
Manufactured Heist.StartDialogue:
Scav. You ever seen those half sunken Titans in the Frozen Swamp?
I've got it on good authoroty that they were hauling some top of the line weapon schematics when they got stuck in the muck.
You wouldn't mind taking a look, would you?
Pretty sure there are things nesting in those husks, so strap up before you head out.
Manufactured Heist.EndDialogue:

Scav Scrap Pt. 1.Description: Europans are moving train cargo through the Frozen Swamp.  If we had their schedule with the attached manifest we could plan which one to hit and when.
Scav Scrap Pt. 1.Author: Slade
Scav Scrap Pt. 1.StartDialogue:
Alright, listen up.
You know the railway that cuts through the Frozen Swamp?
We are planning to lift some cargo that our people could use.
Problem is, until we know which train carries what, we can't really tie up the plan.
That's where you come in. They must keep a schedule and manifest somewhere in that injection well.
If you can get your hands on one, bring it back and we'll talk more.
Scav Scrap Pt. 1.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Steal the train schedule from Frozen Swamp

Scav Scrap Pt. 2.Description: The schedules you lifted for us landed great results. There's some precious cargo moving through the swamps in a short while. Get to the bridge where they conduct their checks and tag the cargo for us.
Scav Scrap Pt. 2.Author: Slade
Scav Scrap Pt. 2.StartDialogue:
Your last job paid off, we got those shipping schedules out of Europa's hands.
One of their trains will be passing through a specific section of the Frozen Swamp in about an hour.
They'll make a stop at the old drawbridge where they do security checks on the cargo.
Get there and plant a tag on whatever it is they're moving.
Scav Scrap Pt. 2.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Tag the cargo for the Scavs

Data Waves.Description: We need some intel on Frozen Swamp, and the Europa FOB is just the place to get it. If our guys went in, they'd wipe the data right away. Get up to their control room and transmit whatever data you can from their drives.
Data Waves.Author: Владелец
Data Waves.StartDialogue:
Hey there Scav. Up for a bit of espionage?
I assume you are familiar with that Europa FOB in the Frozen Swamp, right?
Used to be an injection well way back when. Anyhow.
Thing is, we need some intel on the area, and the control room in that FOB has just the thing.
Now, if we were to storm that place they'd wipe the data as soon as they saw us.
You, however, will be treated as a lesser threat.
I don't care how you do it, just get up to that control room and transmit the data to us.
Data Waves.EndDialogue:

Against One's Camp.Description: Some marksman from that shanty town is causing us quite the headache. Never seen 'em but they've been taking pot shots at our guys, and we have our hands full here as is. Eliminate that pesky sniper for us.
Against One's Camp.Author: Luca
Against One's Camp.StartDialogue:
Listen up, Scav!
Someone from that shanty town has been takin' potshots at our patrols.
Never seen 'em, but they're a damn good shot I'll give 'em that.
Nevertheless, we have our hands full here and can't afford to lose any more men.
Get out there and take out that sniper.
Against One's Camp.EndDialogue:
Listen up, Scav!
Someone from that shanty town has been takin' potshots at our patrols.
Never seen 'em, but they're a damn good shot I'll give 'em that.
Nevertheless, we have our hands full here and can't afford to lose any more men.
Get out there and take out that sniper.

Clear Skies.Description: We've located a low range jammer in the Frozen Swamp. Find it from the cargo of the derailed train and plant it near the drone hives to disable them for us.
Clear Skies.Author: Slade
Clear Skies.StartDialogue:
Listen up, you know how those Euruska drones been buzzing around?
We've found something that can help us put them in their place - an old low-range jammer.
There should be one in the Frozen Swamp among the cargo of the derailed train.
We need you to go get it and plant it near those drone hives we've been tracking.
Once that jammer is in place, our scavengers can move freely without them pesky drones interfering.
Clear Skies.EndDialogue:

VIP Treatment Pt. 1.Description: We've got some intel that some key personnel is about to arrive at the Stairway Gate, but we need to confirm it. If you can find any intel about personnel going in and out, bring it back to me.
VIP Treatment Pt. 1.Author: Владелец
VIP Treatment Pt. 1.StartDialogue:
Hey there, rat. Interested in a job?
We've recieved intel that some key personnel is about to make a visit to the Stairway Gate.
The intel is, however, unconfirmed.
What I need you to do is to confirm it.
Interrogate someone. Find something listing personnel going in and out. I don't care. Just get it done.
VIP Treatment Pt. 1.EndDialogue:
Hey there, rat. Interested in a job?
We've recieved intel that some key personnel is about to make a visit to the Stairway Gate.
The intel is, however, unconfirmed.
What I need you to do is to confirm it.
Interrogate someone. Find something listing personnel going in and out. I don't care. Just get it done.

Cleared to Ascend.Description: There's a crackshot sniper keepin' an eye out at Stairway Gate. Bastard's got a nest overlooking the whole lower area. Take him out.
Cleared to Ascend.Author: Luca
Cleared to Ascend.StartDialogue:
Hey, Scav!
You're heading to The Stairs anytime soon?
Listen, there's somethin' I got to ask of you.
Me and a couple guys from my unit barely made it out last we reconed the area.
Some Euruskan bastard set up shop right up in the middle. Nice and tucked in.
My CO dropped, and then came the crack...
By the time we found cover he dropped two others.
Anyhow... If you can take that bastard out, there's something good for you in it.
Cleared to Ascend.EndDialogue:

VIP Treatment Pt. 2.Description: The intel you brought got us some results. There's a VIP stationed at their base currently. Now, we can't just roll in there. That'd be suicide. But you rats might be able to slip in and do the guy in.
VIP Treatment Pt. 2.Author: Владелец
VIP Treatment Pt. 2.StartDialogue:
Ha! If it isn't my favorite rat.
Listen, that data you gave us confirmed our previous intel.
Now, we could just roll in, but that would border on suicide.
You, however, have your rat ways, and might be able to slip in to do the guy in.
Here's all the info you need to find him. You know what to do.

Bond of Brothers.Description: Listen, my buddy stationed at Stairway Gate went radiosilent. It's not like I can just abandon my unit to go look for him, so could you?
Bond of Brothers.Author: Luca
Bond of Brothers.StartDialogue:
Hey, scav, listen.
You headed to The Stairs anytime soon?
I've been in radio contact with a buddy of mine there, but he went silent a couple days ago.
I'm in no condition to travel. Could you look for him?
I know he's probably dead... But at least I'd know for sure.
Bond of Brothers.EndDialogue:

HIDDEN Anti-Air Extinguisher.Description: We can't carve out a foothold at the Stairway Gate without bringing in our own air support. Which means those SAM launchers have to go.
HIDDEN Anti-Air Extinguisher.Author: Luca
HIDDEN Anti-Air Extinguisher.StartDialogue:
Listen up, scav.
We're planning an aerial assault of the Stairway Gate.
To do that, we need to get rid of a few SAM launchers.
I haven't the troops to spare so I'm offering the job to you.
Naturally, I'm authorized to compensate you if you can get the job done.
Good luck.
HIDDEN Anti-Air Extinguisher.EndDialogue:

Good luck.

Science of Stimulants.Description: Euruska is testing out some new booster drugs on the troops stationed at stairways. Now, we're not the kinda animals to drug up our troops, but for research purposes, our guys would love to take a look. Get us a few samples. You can probably find them on the troops.
Science of Stimulants.Author: Luca
Science of Stimulants.StartDialogue:
Listen up, scav.
We've got reports of Euruskans testing out some new combat stimulant drug on their troops.
Now, we're not the kind of animals to pump our guys with this kind of shit. But our scientists would love to take a look.
If you can find us a few intact samples, we'll compensate you.
Intel suggests that their primary testing area is at The Stairs.
Science of Stimulants.EndDialogue:
Listen up, scav.

Now, we're not the kind of animals to pump our guys with this kind of shit. But our scientists would love to take a look.

HIDDEN Family Connections.Description: Hey, listen. Are you going to the Stairway Gate anytime soon? My pops, he never left, not even when Euruska started rolling in. Anyway. Could you bring this radio to him? At the very least I could keep in touch with that stubborn, old bastard.
HIDDEN Family Connections.Author: Slade
HIDDEN Family Connections.StartDialogue:
Heading to The Stairs?
Could you drop this radio off at my pops'?
Stubborn old bastard refused to come with us. Even when the bombs came.
At least this way I could talk to him.
HIDDEN Family Connections.EndDialogue:
Heading to The Stairs?
Could you drop this radio off at my pops'?
Stubborn old bastard refused to come with us. Even when the bombs came.
At least this way I could talk to him.

Objectives.Text: Deliver the Radio to the Scav's Father

Goose Chase.Description: Our recon unit tasked with feeding false intel to the Euruskans went silent. We can't move until that transmission goes out. Find that unit, find their transmitter and activate it.
Goose Chase.Author: Luca
Goose Chase.StartDialogue:
Scav. Listen, time is of the essence.
One of our units went dark at The Stairs.
They were tasked with feeding the Euruskans some false intel so we can roll in.
I can't spare a soul to get this done, so it falls to you. 
Find that unit, their transmitter and broadcast the data. We'll know when it's done.
And don't worry. You will be compensated.
Goose Chase.EndDialogue:

Objectives.Text: Find the radio equipment and transmit the false intel.

HIDDEN Shattered Memories.Description: My wife and I had a home near the stairways. There was a bombing, and she got buried beneath the rubble. I had to grab my kid and run. No time to look back. If there's still something standing of that building, please find a photo we had. A framed one of the three of us. I'd mean the world to us.

HIDDEN Shattered Memories.StartDialogue:
Hey. Are you headed to the Stairway Gate?
My wife and I had a home there. Before the bombings.
My wife got buried in the rubble.
I- I had to grab my kid and run. Couldn't look back.
We had a photo. Of the three of us. 
Could you please look for it next time you're in that area?
It'd mean the world to us.

Water Wars.Description: We heard there's a big stash of water somewhere in the Frozen Swamp. Problem is, we also heard that it's guarded by Water Thieves. If you can get rid of them, we can start prepping to go out there and bring that water back here. Be sure you're up for this before butting heads with them, beacuse they will retaliate if the initial assault fails.

HIDDEN Trial by Extraction Pt.1.Description: Bunco promises a substantial reward for those who can navigate the dangers of Scorched Enclave and return successfully.

Trial by Extraction Pt.1.Description: Bunco's willing to pay top dollar for a successful extraction from Elephant Mausoleum.
Trial by Extraction Pt.1.Author: Bunco
Trial by Extraction Pt.1.StartDialogue:
Hey scav. I see you around often, and I have a good feeling about you.
You look like you carry much more inside of you, and the scavs could use fighters of your... ambition.

Dead Men Walking.Author: Bunco
Dead Men Walking.StartDialogue:
My faith is nearly restored, Scav.
I see you, and your ambitious crew. You remind me of my youth.
Show us that you can work AND survive. Not to create havoc, but to keep safe. Infiltrate the Mausoleum, and leave without having a single member fall.

Electro-Magnetic Railway Pt.1.Author: Bunco
Electro-Magnetic Railway Pt.1.StartDialogue:
Look Scav. You've earned my trust so I'll let you in on a little something.
Have you ever seen a small blue flash, followed by a sonic crack and mech being punched clean through?
That, my friend, is a railgun. Eurasian tech. Not a lot of those as I understand.
A bitch to carry, deploy, but it will make anything you point at go away.
I've got my hands on some classified Eurasian documents, so the concept, I have.
What I don't have are the components to build the parts that build the gun.
If you're up for this, we can work together to bring one to life.
I'll get to study and tinker, and you'll get to take it with you once I'm done.
Sounds good? Good.
Alright. Firstly, we need the rails. Essentially the barrels of the gun.
If we can't get those, or they aren't in prime condition, we can kiss the whole thing goodbye.
A little bird told me they have a stockpile of 'em in Elephant. 
Find a pair and bring 'em back to me. Simple as. 
But of course expect anything related to their experimental weapon to be under heavy guard.
Good luck.

Electro-Magnetic Railway Pt.2.StartDialogue:
Alright, the rails are indeed in perfect condition. 
Next up, we need a breech system.
Put together, they form the gun part of our gun.
It's supposedly a very delicate piece of equipment, so we need one in perfect condition.
I couldn't tell you where to start looking, but my best guess would be the Scrapyard.
As before, if you find one bring it here and we'll take a look at it.
Don't get killed, eh?

Electro-Magnetic Railway Pt.3.Author: Bunco
Electro-Magnetic Railway Pt.3.StartDialogue:
Well. I'm sorry to say that the breech system you brough is a dud.
Some of the couplings are too banged up to fit, and I just don't have the precision machinery to fix the issues.
You'll have to grab another one if we want to see this through.
With all that being said...
You might have better luck there than in the Scrapyard.
Good luck.
